title: Ireland Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Ireland study visa from Pakistan (EU (not Schengen)): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Ireland study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Offer from an eligible Irish education provider; Proof of funds meeting Irish guidance; English language evidence; Passport and online application. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Ireland from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Ireland is generally mid-to-high cost. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Ireland study visa?
faqs.answer: Usually required at college-set bands (IELTS or accepted alternatives).

faqs.question: Can I study in Ireland with low marks?
faqs.answer: Selective for quality colleges; pathway programmes exist — we assess risk honestly.

faqs.question: How long does Ireland student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 2–5 months after offer, depending on queues.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Ireland student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport; Offer letter; Bank statements; English test; Academics; Insurance.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Ireland?
faqs.answer: Student work hours are limited in term — funds proof cannot depend on illegal work.

faqs.question: How to apply for Ireland study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Ireland study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Ireland student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.

Ireland study from Pakistan — separate from UK

Ireland uses its own student immigration permission. Pakistani applicants need admission from an eligible Irish institution, funds, and online application steps — not a UK student visa.

Building blocks

  • Offer letter / admission evidence
  • Proof of funds per INIS guidance
  • English evidence matching programme
  • Online application and biometrics when required

Mistakes

  • Assuming UK CAS covers Ireland
  • Funds only shown as one-day balance
  • Weak study purpose narrative
